title: DC nodal solver with Newton iteration

implements.text: Newton iteration on the nodal equations with SPICE default tolerances: relative 1e-3, voltage 1 uV, current 1 pA, at most 100 iterations
Shockley diode and LED, Gummel-Poon BJT and MOSFET stamps with junction voltage limiting

unsupported.text: Capacitors and inductors: DC only until a transient backend lands
Temperature dependence of the device parameters

knownFailureCases: No test in the repository runs this solver against a reference, so it carries no more than T0
A circuit that does not settle within the iteration cap
